purpose: Test whether the reward gate can use the already learnable and mutually distilled dual priors. Preserve the original bidirectional stop-gradient mutual-distillation formula and weight exactly, change only gate-to-detached-fused-prior alignment, and do not enable reconstruction, containment, or any other CLIR module.

method.name: reward_gate_to_detached_fused_dual_prior_alignment
method.gate_attention: normalize(sigmoid(gate_logits)) over the full valid trajectory
method.fused_prior: normalize(0.5 * A_key + 0.5 * A_complete) over the full valid trajectory
method.token_reduction: Sum squared token errors within each trajectory, then average trajectories.
method.gradient_destination: reward gate and shared upstream representation only; A_fused is detached inside the objective
method.weight_rationale: The frozen M1 scale audit found that weight 0.25 yields a median gate-head gradient only 0.6% as large as final-BCE gate-head gradient. Among predeclared candidates 0.25, 1, 5, and 10, weight 10 is the smallest entering the 15%-50% median target band; its maximum audited gate-head ratio remains below 1 and its maximum shared-encoder ratio remains below 5%.

g0_mutual_no_gate_alignment.description: Matched M1 control: correctness plus direct key/complete BCE and the original mutual-distillation objective at 0.25, with reward-gate alignment disabled.

g1_mutual_plus_gate_alignment.description: G0 plus reward-gate alignment to the detached 0.5/0.5 fused dual prior at the independently frozen weight 10.0.

evaluation.primary_integration_metric: Held-out full-trajectory mean sum-squared error between normalized reward-gate attention and the detached 0.5/0.5 fused prior; this exactly matches the unweighted training objective on the fully labeled pilot rows.
evaluation.membership_prediction: sigmoid(key_prior_logits) and sigmoid(complete_prior_logits), never trajectory-softmax attention
gate_diagnostics: gate-to-fused-prior MSE, L1 distance, overlap mass, and cosine similarity
gate and fused-prior normalized entropy, effective-token fraction, uniform-distance, and maximum token mass
raw mean sigmoid gate and final/token/residual score distributions
evaluation.passing_conclusion: The reward gate learned the detached fused dual-prior target on held-out pilot rows without unacceptable localization, mutual-collaboration, map-separation, correctness, or collapse regression. Retain this gate integration for a separately frozen query-grouped ranking/Best-of-N experiment; do not claim ranking improvement from this one-candidate-per-query pilot.
evaluation.failing_conclusion: Keep the direct dual-prior heads and original mutual-distillation method, but do not yet integrate their fused map into the production reward gate. Treat weight 10.0 as a failed or diagnostic-only frozen setting and diagnose optimization or architecture under a new protocol without changing this result post hoc.
